head_note: plan14.md commit; src/ is identical to 4466d1a, the HEAD of the plan-session probes
cli: preflight enabled (the detector does not fire on the measured roots: all have >3 men or pawns)

main_tt_buckets.128 MB label: 2^19 buckets (4 x 56 B entries per 224 B bucket)

notes: The plan-session probe build enlarged TtEntry to 80 B and used capacity-matched labels (160 MB probe = 128 MB product bucket count; 320 MB probe = 256 MB product bucket count). This spike keeps the product 56 B TtEntry and a separate side table, so the product labels above are used directly and main-table capacity is not modified.
All runs are sequential (one process per run) and use child_evals as the primary metric; wall time is recorded but not used for verdicts.
dec01 is censored at its 120 s timeout, so its child_evals value at the cut is wall-clock dependent and is not a replay anchor.
